node.releasePolicy: Public 1.0.6+ builds ship the native Swift runtime (roachnet-runtime) and no Node. The pin is used only when ROACHNET_BUNDLE_NODE_COMPAT=1 builds a legacy compatibility payload.

ollama.reviewNotes: 2026-10-09: 0.40.2 (published 2026-10-08) SHA-256 and size match the GitHub release digest; archive file list is identical to 0.40.1 (which matched 0.33.1). Patch release: model-upgrade backups, ollama list de-duplication, launch context length. Mac Gate C must pull and chat with a model before tagging. 2026-10-10: OSV (pkg:golang/github.com/ollama/ollama@v0.40.2) lists nine open Go advisories with no fixed version; each is accepted below with its loopback-only reasoning for 1.0.6.

acceptedAdvisories.reason: Resource exhaustion by a crafted GGUF import; Ollama is loopback-only in RoachNet and only loads models the local user chose. No upstream fix version is published.
Out-of-bounds read via a crafted model file; same loopback-only, user-chosen-model exposure.
Divide-by-zero on a crafted model; local denial of service only.
Null dereference on a crafted request; local denial of service only.
Divide-by-zero on a crafted GGUF; local denial of service only.
Server denial of service via crafted requests; reachable only from the same Mac.
Cross-domain token exposure applies to registry pulls with user-configured hosts; RoachNet pulls only from the default registry.
Missing authentication on model management is Ollama's documented local trust model; the server is bound to 127.0.0.1 and reachable only by local processes, like every other local port.

Path traversal through crafted model manifests; mitigated by loopback-only exposure and user-chosen models. Revisit if Ollama publishes a fixed module version; 1.1 retires the bundled Ollama (ROA-30).

openclaw.releasePolicy: Public release builds fail if ROACHNET_BUNDLE_OPENCLAW=1; unlocked npm install output is not permitted in the artifact.
